text: Which retina-specific genes are enhanced in rod photoreceptor cells (single-cell)?
plan: Tissue category (RNA): Retina / Tissue enriched AND Cell type category (scRNA): Rod photoreceptor cells / Cell type enhanced
understanding: The user is looking for genes that show tissue specificity in the retina (at the bulk RNA level across tissues) and are enhanced in rod photoreceptor cells at the single-cell RNA-seq level.

trail.why: Tissue enriched defines genes with at least four-fold higher mRNA expression in retina compared to any other tissue, representing tissue-specific expression.
The requirement asks for genes enhanced in rod photoreceptor cells at the single-cell level, matching the cell type 'Rod photoreceptor cells' and category 'Cell type enhanced'.
